ports.note: Area is acquisition context for OSM; file inputs do not require it.

ontology.note: GeoSPARQL geometry, PROV activity and QUDT buffer units. The mode the graph was filtered for is asserted as fw:travelMode on the network entity -- the term reachability already uses for the mode it assumes -- from src/catchments.ts, so it is declared on the release whose definition is that module rather than here. Configuration SHACL is future work.

changes.description: On the standard Inspector: one sentence of what it holds and where it comes from, the download, file or extract that way needs, and Configure… for the way in, the travel mode, the margin, the pause and the graph limit. The Result gives the junctions and streets held. Moved off the old catchment panel to network-input-ui.ts.

evidence.note: Acquisition only; the graph it produces is checked where it is used. The pacing follows the service's own /api/status rather than a client-side guess, measured against OSMnx's behaviour on 2026-10-19. 0.14.0: tests/network-mode, travel-mode-default, street-engine, catchments, payload-store-fallback, large-network-storage, large-project-package and encrypted-project-roundtrip through Configure… and Apply; Chromium, 2026-11-23.
